verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.granola.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an index of Granola Docs & Help Center pages. The docs themselves are served as markdown (.md) URLs, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-readable documentation. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404), no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other agent-specific guidance, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using the docs.
